heading.title: Of Mortgages of Immoveable Property and Charges

article.title: 8 [References to mortgagors and mortgagees to include persons deriving title from them.
article.content:
59A8[References to mortgagors and mortgagees to include persons deriving title from them.

Section 59A  ·  Chapter IV  ·  page 24 of the Act
Unless otherwise expressly provided, references in this Chapter to mortgagors and mortgagees shall be deemed to include references to persons deriving title from them respectively.]
8 Ins. by Act 20 of 1929, s. 21
